title: The audit log
summary: KloudC masters: every sign-in and change on the platform, who did it and when.

blocks.text: The **Audit** tab lists everything done on the platform, newest first: sign-ins (good and failed), approvals, status changes, settings changes, hosting steps and support sessions.

items: Filter by store, or by action (for example login.failed).
Entries can't be edited or deleted.
Use it to answer "who changed this, and when?" before asking anyone.
